requirement.statement: 系统 SHALL guide and validate the XNL *form* of modeling nodes so that LLM authors produce spec-conformant nodes — component IO blocks as bare tags, shell-kind nodes as plain element tags plus a `kind` attribute — while the validate engine accepts the common role-tagged IO variant for compatibility. Derived from E2E dogfood where a real model (codex gpt-5.5) wrote conceptually-correct modeling but tripped on these two XNL-form ambiguities across 3/3 and 1/3 topics.

case.given: A modeling `component` node needing runtime/input/config/output blocks.
case.when: An author writes it per spec.
case.then: The canonical form SHALL be bare tags `<runtime>` / `<input>` / `<config>` / `<output>`, and `modeling-node-schema.md` + `xnl-format.md` SHALL state this explicitly with Good/Bad examples.

case.given: A `component` whose IO blocks are written as `<types role="runtime">` (and input/config/output) instead of bare tags.
case.then: The schema layer SHALL accept a role-tagged block as satisfying the corresponding runtime/input/config/output requirement (compatibility), without raising the "requires a <slot> block" error.
case.and: Bare tags remain the canonical, spec-recommended form; role-tagged is accepted-but-discouraged.

case.given: A shell-kind modeling node (e.g. a backend endpoint or a surface route).
case.when: An author writes its XNL element.
case.then: The element tag SHALL be a plain word (e.g. `<endpoint>`, `<route>`) carrying the namespaced kind in the `kind` attribute (`kind="backend:endpoint"`); the element tag name MUST NOT contain a colon (XNL element tags cannot).
case.and: `modeling-node-schema.md` + `xnl-format.md` SHALL show Good (`<endpoint kind="backend:endpoint">`) vs Bad (`<backend:endpoint …>` → XNL syntax error) examples.

case.given: A track-creation or implement step that generates/edits `modeling_deltas` while modeling is enabled.
case.then: The workflow SHALL run `codument modeling validate --deltas <track>` and surface + repair findings before proceeding.
case.and: This step SHALL be gated on `config/modeling.xml` (skipped when modeling is disabled), consistent with other modeling behavior.
